WITH product_volumes AS (
  SELECT p.product_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))), 0) AS order_volume
  FROM Products p
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         order_volume,
         order_volume / NULLIF(SUM(order_volume) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM product_volumes
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ps.order_volume) AS combined_order_volume,
       AVG(ps.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ps.share - av.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM product_shares ps
CROSS JOIN average_share av
WHERE ps.share > av.avg_share;
